players.product: Temporary bonding / debonding systems for wafer thinning and coaters / developers for advanced packaging (WLP / PLP)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January-June 2026) segment results (Coater now included in Semiconductor Equipment from Q1 FY2026): Process Equipment net sales JPY 10,668 million (-12.5%), operating income JPY 220 million (-88.5%); Transfer Equipment JPY 3,452 million (-11.7%), as orders are recovering but few projects could be booked as sales; Cleaning Equipment JPY 1,135 million (-4.9%) as wafer makers' capex slowed; Molds & Resin Molding JPY 563 million (-7%), operating loss JPY 2 million on higher raw-material prices and factory-relocation costs; Surface Treatment Equipment JPY 1,452 million (-63.6%), operating loss JPY 89 million on delayed acceptance of shipped equipment. Ordinary profit JPY 270 million (-88.6%); net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 35 million (-97.8%). Management states AI-server demand remained strong, with memory still in short supply and prices rising.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 12,684,558 thousand; Process Equipment JPY 10,668,294 thousand; Transfer Equipment JPY 3,452,604 thousand; Surface Treatment JPY 1,452,311 thousand; ordinary profit JPY 270,900 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 orders received JPY 47,770,007 thousand, 489.1% of the prior-year period, lifting the order backlog to 226.9% of a year earlier; production (at cost) JPY 9,248,185 thousand (78.4%). Management states that orders rose because semiconductor makers' capex is on a recovery trend.
quarterly_data.figure: Orders received JPY 47,770,007 thousand (489.1% YoY); production JPY 9,248,185 thousand (78.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 R&D expenses JPY 541 million, mainly Process Equipment development (no material change in R&D activities); purchase of property, plant and equipment JPY 1,327 million in the half.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 541,194 thousand; PP&E purchases JPY 1,327,090 thousand
